title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Begin by drawing the first face of the rectangular object. In the first loop, draw a line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.15, 0.0), then from (0.15, 0.0) to (0.15, 0.75), followed by a line from (0.15, 0.75) to (0.0, 0.75), and finally from (0.0, 0.75) back to the origin. For the second loop, start at (0.03, 0.045) and draw a line to (0.06, 0.045), then to (0.06, 0.0675), to (0.09, 0.0675), to (0.09, 0.045), and to (0.12, 0.045). Continue with a line from (0.12, 0.045) to (0.12, 0.705), then to (0.09, 0.705), to (0.09, 0.6825), to (0.06, 0.6825), to (0.06, 0.705), and to (0.03, 0.705). Finally, draw a line from (0.03, 0.705) back to (0.03, 0.045). Scale the entire two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.75. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it using Euler angles set to zero and translating it with a vector also set to zero. Extrude the two-dimensional sketch 0.01 units along the normal direction to create a solid body. The final dimensions of the rectangular object with rounded edges are 0.15 units in length, 0.75 units in width, and 0.01 units in height.

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the outer rectangle
r = r.box(0.15, 0.75, 0.01, centered=(False, False, False))

# Define the inner cutout
inner_cutout = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0.03, 0.045).lineTo(0.06, 0.045).lineTo(0.06, 0.0675).lineTo(0.09, 0.0675).lineTo(0.09, 0.045).lineTo(0.12, 0.045).lineTo(0.12, 0.705).lineTo(0.09, 0.705).lineTo(0.09, 0.6825).lineTo(0.06, 0.6825).lineTo(0.06, 0.705).lineTo(0.03, 0.705).lineTo(0.03, 0.045).close()

# Extrude the inner cutout
inner_cutout = inner_cutout.extrude(0.01)

# Cut the inner cutout from the outer rectangle
r = r.cut(inner_cutout)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Outer dimensions
outer_x = 0.15
outer_y = 0.75
thickness = 0.01

# Inner opening dimensions
wall = 0.025
inner_x0, inner_x1 = wall, outer_x - wall
inner_y0, inner_y1 = 0.05, outer_y - 0.05

# Tab (material protruding into the opening) dimensions
tab_w = 0.025
tab_d = 0.025
tab_x0 = (outer_x - tab_w) / 2.0
tab_x1 = (outer_x + tab_w) / 2.0

# Base plate
r = cq.Workplane("XY").box(outer_x, outer_y, thickness, centered=(True, True, False))

# Cut the main inner opening
cut = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=-0.01) \
    .moveTo(inner_x0, inner_y0).lineTo(inner_x1, inner_y0) \
    .lineTo(inner_x1, inner_y1).lineTo(inner_x0, inner_y1).close() \
    .extrude(0.03)
r = r.cut(cut)

# Cut away around the top tab (leave tab material)
cut_top = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=-0.01) \
    .moveTo(inner_x0, inner_y1 - tab_d).lineTo(tab_x0, inner_y1 - tab_d) \
    .lineTo(tab_x0, inner_y1).lineTo(inner_x0, inner_y1).close() \
    .extrude(0.03)
r = r.cut(cut_top)

cut_top2 = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=-0.01) \
    .moveTo(tab_x1, inner_y1 - tab_d).lineTo(inner_x1, inner_y1 - tab_d) \
    .lineTo(inner_x1, inner_y1).lineTo(tab_x1, inner_y1).close() \
    .extrude(0.03)
r = r.cut(cut_top2)

# Cut away around the bottom tab (leave tab material)
cut_bot = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=-0.01) \
    .moveTo(inner_x0, inner_y0).lineTo(tab_x0, inner_y0) \
    .lineTo(tab_x0, inner_y0 + tab_d).lineTo(inner_x0, inner_y0 + tab_d).close() \
    .extrude(0.03)
r = r.cut(cut_bot)

cut_bot2 = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=-0.01) \
    .moveTo(tab_x1, inner_y0).lineTo(inner_x1, inner_y0) \
    .lineTo(inner_x1, inner_y0 + tab_d).lineTo(tab_x1, inner_y0 + tab_d).close() \
    .extrude(0.03)
r = r.cut(cut_bot2)

import cadquery as cq

# Outer thin plate: X 0.15, Y 0.75, Z 0.01 (origin at a corner)
base = cq.Workplane("XY").box(0.15, 0.75, 0.01, centered=(False, False, False))

# Inner through-cut profile: long central slot with a narrow rectangular
# notch/tab at each end (centered in X), matching the TOP view.
pts = [
    (0.060, 0.030),
    (0.090, 0.030),
    (0.090, 0.045),
    (0.130, 0.045),
    (0.130, 0.705),
    (0.090, 0.705),
    (0.090, 0.720),
    (0.060, 0.720),
    (0.060, 0.705),
    (0.020, 0.705),
    (0.020, 0.045),
    (0.060, 0.045),
]

cutout = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .polyline(pts)
    .close()
    .extrude(0.01)
)

r = base.cut(cutout)
